Class GenerateFromJsonSchemaSourcesMojo

java.lang.Object
org.apache.maven.plugin.AbstractMojo

io.micronaut.jsonschema.maven.GenerateFromJsonSchemaSourcesMojo
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.plugin.ContextEnabled, org.apache.maven.plugin.Mojo
@Mojo(name="generate-from-json-schema-sources", defaultPhase=GENERATE_SOURCES, threadSafe=true) public class GenerateFromJsonSchemaSourcesMojo extends AbstractGenerateFromJsonSchemaSourcesMojo
Maven goal that discovers JSON Schemas and generates Java records.
